implementation.behavior: lookup_engine_server holds an ETS table keyed by short code, refreshed from Postgres on link creation and retirement; lookup/1 reads ETS directly.
implementation.invariants: A lookup for a retired code returns :not_found within one write of the retirement landing.
implementation.sequencing: Table refresh happens synchronously inside the same transaction that creates or retires a link, before the caller's write returns.
implementation.edge-cases: A lookup racing a concurrent retirement sees either the old or the new state, never a torn read - ETS's own atomicity covers it.

tests.test: Create a link, look it up, assert the target URL matches.
Create then retire a link, look it up, assert :not_found.
